text:
Maya: Post-cutoff sanity check — we're ready to tag v1.8.0 and swap the draft assets? I want to avoid the last-minute checksum mismatch we saw.
Jon: CI green, build artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0/. I ran a quick smoke on the integration tests.
Sasha: Who's doing the GH draft -> publish step this time? Last publish failed for me due to permissions.
Kevin: I can do it, but I need confirmation on which commit to tag from. Is it the release branch (release/1.8) or the rc branch?
Maya: Tag from release/1.8 (no ff). Make an annotated tag and include the changelog summary. Example:
```
git checkout release/1.8
git pull origin release/1.8
git tag -a v1.8.0 -m "v1.8.0 — changelog: bump runtime, fix batching edgecase"
git push origin v1.8.0
```
Jon: Asset checklist for whoever publishes:
- Verify sha256 checksums: `sha256sum * | tee checksums.txt`
- Upload the artifact bundle to the draft release (we use `gh`):
```
gh release upload v1.8.0 path/to/bundle.tar.gz --clobber
```
- Paste checksums into release body and mark the draft as ready.
Sasha: Also remember to attach the SBOM and signed manifest. The signing key is in vault under `release/signing/key-v1`.
Kevin: I have the GH token in my session. I'll run the publish step once Jon confirms checksums match and Sasha confirms SBOM is attached. I'll post the `gh` output here.
release-bot: Draft release v1.8.0 created by CI — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.8.0 (draft)
Maya: Quick reminder: don't change the commit after tagging. If you need a fix, push a new rc and cut a new tag.
Jon: Checksums look good. `checksums.txt` matches S3: yes. SBOM is uploaded.
Kevin: Running publish now.
Kevin: `gh release edit v1.8.0 --draft=false` -> exit 0
Kevin: Publish complete. URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.8.0 :tada:
Sasha: I'll monitor downloads and the release webhook for any post-publish CI hooks. Ping me if telemetry spikes.
Maya: Thanks all. Leaving a small follow-up: I'll add a one-line entry in the release notes about the batching fix. If anyone sees any missing asset, reopen the draft and ping.
Jon: :thumbsup:
